entries.summary: Zoom API sync features: host key sync button, reschedule sync, cancel/trash delete sync, recording fetch
changes: class-oha-ve-zoom-api.php: added get_user(), update_meeting(), delete_meeting(), get_recordings() API methods
class-oha-ve-zoom-api.php: maybe_sync_on_save() hook at priority 999 - auto-delete on cancel + auto reschedule sync
class-oha-ve-zoom-api.php: maybe_delete_on_trash() hook - auto-delete Zoom meeting when event is trashed
class-oha-ve-zoom-api.php: maybe_sync_meeting_time() helper - compares GD schedule to last synced baseline, PATCHes only on change
class-oha-ve-zoom-api.php: create_meeting() now stores oha_ve_zoom_synced_start baseline so reschedule sync skips the initial create
class-oha-ve-zoom-api.php: AJAX handlers ajax_sync_host_key, ajax_sync_meeting_time, ajax_fetch_recording
class-oha-ve-settings.php: new constants OPT_HOST_KEY_SYNCED, OPT_AUTO_RESCHEDULE, OPT_AUTO_CANCEL_DELETE, OPT_AUTO_TRASH_DELETE
class-oha-ve-settings.php: new Zoom API Sync settings section with 3 toggles (reschedule, cancel-delete, trash-delete)
class-oha-ve-settings.php: host key field replaced with render_host_key_field() - adds Sync from Zoom button + last-synced timestamp
class-oha-ve-settings.php: credentials section now mentions user:read:admin scope requirement with setup note
class-oha-ve-admin.php: Section 4 (Zoom) - Sync Date/Time to Zoom manual button with last-synced label
class-oha-ve-admin.php: Section 6 (Replay) - Fetch Recording from Zoom button with results table (share URL, file list, download links)
class-oha-ve-admin.php: JS for both new buttons using $.post AJAX

entries.summary: Security: validated zoom.us domain + HTTPS scheme before Zoom join redirect
entries.notes: zoom_join_redirect() REST endpoint now validates that the stored Zoom join URL uses the https:// scheme and a zoom.us hostname before calling wp_redirect(). Prevents potential open redirect if the stored URL were ever malformed or tampered with at DB level. Returns 400 with wp_die message for invalid URLs.

entries.summary: Security: enforce numeric-only Zoom meeting IDs by stripping all non-digit characters
entries.notes: Replaced preg_replace('/\s+/', ...) with preg_replace('/\D/', ...) in three locations: class-oha-ve-frontend.php (zoom_start URL builder), class-oha-ve-shortcodes.php (render_event_card zoom_start URL builder), class-oha-ve-zoom-webhooks.php (find_event_by_zoom_id). Zoom Meeting IDs are always purely numeric; this is more correct and secure than stripping only whitespace.

entries.summary: Security: apply esc_url_raw() to Zoom share_url from recording.completed webhook payload
entries.notes: In handle_recording_completed(), the share_url value from Zoom's webhook payload now passes through esc_url_raw() before being concatenated into Admin Notes. Adds URL sanitization defense-in-depth even though the webhook is already HMAC-SHA256 verified.

entries.summary: Fixed white-on-white paragraph text inside Zoom/YouTube/replay cards
entries.notes: Added .oha-ve-card p { color: #333 !important; } rule. Affects the instructional paragraph text in the Zoom card ('You are the host...' and 'Click below to join...'). The !important override defeats theme CSS that was setting p color to white inside card elements.

entries.summary: Zoom join URL is now hidden from page source via a protected REST API redirect
entries.notes: New REST endpoint: GET /wp-json/oha-ve/v1/zoom-join/{event_id}?_wpnonce=... - verifies WordPress nonce, login state, and event access level, then wp_redirect() to the Zoom URL. The raw Zoom join URL no longer appears in any HTML rendered to the browser. Static helper OHA_VE_Frontend::get_protected_join_url($event_id) builds the protected URL. Applied in: event detail page join button, host view attendee link, My Account hub card join button, live banner join button. Invalid nonce, not-logged-in, or unauthorized users get a descriptive wp_die message.

entries.summary: Redesigned [oha_live_banner] as compact Spotify-style header bar
entries.notes: Banner now designed for full-width header placement. Includes album art panel (featured image or dark placeholder with equalizer), animated equalizer bars in the meta row, event title, start-end time string from wp_geodir_event_schedule table. get_event_schedule() updated to SELECT end_date and end_time in addition to start fields.

entries.summary: Added cancelled event state to [oha_live_banner]
entries.notes: Banner now queries both live and cancelled events (live takes priority). Cancelled events display within their scheduled time window with grey dot, frozen equalizer bars, and 'This event has been cancelled' message. Server-side check: if past end time, status auto-updates to closed and banner returns empty. Inline JS also hides the cancelled banner client-side after end time. Cancelled events before start time are not shown yet.

entries.summary: Added event-type-based default button labels for banner and hub cards
entries.notes: Button label priority: (1) oha_ve_zoom_btn_label if set, (2) event-type default, (3) 'Join Meeting'. Defaults: member_education=Join Session, pre_recorded=Watch Recording, actor_meetup=Join Meetup, member_townhall=Join Town Hall, other_virtual=Join Event. Applied in both sc_live_banner() and render_event_card().

entries.summary: Fixed white-on-white card title text caused by theme color inheritance
entries.notes: Added !important to all color declarations on .oha-ve-card-title, .oha-edu-card-title a, .oha-ve-meta, and related text elements. Theme was overriding the dark color with white on certain page templates.

entries.summary: Modernized event card and hub card styles to match OHA dark/gold/red theme
entries.notes: Cards now use white backgrounds with box-shadow instead of flat tinted backgrounds. Hover state lifts shadow. Border-left accents retained for live/teach/zoom/youtube card types. All text colors explicitly set with !important to prevent theme overrides. Type badges, live badges, and section titles updated for consistency.

entries.summary: Added per-event custom join button label field (oha_ve_zoom_btn_label)
entries.notes: New meta key: oha_ve_zoom_btn_label. Text input in admin meta box Zoom section. Defaults to Join Meeting when blank. Applies to the attendee join button on both the gd_event detail page (class-oha-ve-frontend.php) and the My Account hub card (class-oha-ve-shortcodes.php). Saved via existing text_fields array in save_meta.

entries.summary: Added [oha_live_banner] shortcode for homepage live event indicator
entries.notes: New shortcode for homepage or any page. When any gd_event has oha_ve_event_status=live and oha_ve_show_in_hub=1, shows a dark OHA-themed banner with pulsing dot and event title. Users with access see a flashing red LIVE join button linking to the Zoom join URL if set, otherwise the event page. Users without access see a locked amber variant with Become a Member and Register buttons. Returns empty string when no live event exists. Attributes: membership_url (default /membership/), register_url (default /register/).

entries.summary: Phase 2 - Zoom Server-to-Server OAuth API integration
entries.notes: Added class-oha-ve-zoom-api.php: singleton, token cache (55 min WP transient), create_meeting() that auto-fills oha_ve_zoom_id, oha_ve_zoom_join_url, oha_ve_zoom_meeting_uuid, oha_ve_zoom_start_url post meta. Auto-creates meeting on publish_gd_event if auto-create setting is enabled and no meeting exists yet. API errors shown as dismissible admin notices.

entries.summary: Phase 2 - Zoom webhook receiver REST endpoint
entries.notes: Added class-oha-ve-zoom-webhooks.php. REST endpoint /wp-json/oha-ve/v1/zoom-webhook handles: endpoint.url_validation (Zoom setup challenge), meeting.started (sets status=live), meeting.ended (sets status=closed), recording.completed (sets status=replay, marks archive_enabled, appends Zoom share URL to Admin Notes). All non-validation requests verified via HMAC-SHA256 with 5-minute replay-attack window.

entries.summary: Phase 2 - Admin settings page at Settings > OHA Virtual Events
entries.notes: Added class-oha-ve-settings.php. Settings page stores Zoom Account ID, Client ID, Client Secret, Webhook Secret Token, auto-create toggle, default meeting settings (auto-record, waiting room, host video, duration). Password fields preserve existing value when saved blank. Test Connection button does live AJAX call to Zoom OAuth endpoint. Page also includes full shortcode reference, access level guide, replay workflow, and one-time oha_instructor role registration snippet.

entries.summary: Admin meta box Zoom section updated with Phase 2 status and Meeting UUID display
entries.notes: Zoom section now shows contextual Phase 2 status: green notice when API + auto-create are active, info tip with link to settings when configured but auto-create is off, standard manual-entry tip when not configured. Meeting UUID (oha_ve_zoom_meeting_uuid) displayed read-only once auto-created.

entries.summary: Replaced all em dash characters with plain ASCII dashes across all PHP files
entries.notes: Em dashes (U+2014) in PHP string literals and HTML output can cause encoding issues on some server configurations. Replaced with standard hyphen-minus throughout all four plugin files.

entries.summary: Added devlog.json for Board Hub dev log aggregator integration
entries.notes: Plugin now ships with devlog.json in root. OHA Dev Log Aggregator plugin will pick this up automatically and surface the full change history in the Board Hub dev log shortcode.

entries.summary: Added OHA Instructor role management to WP Users Edit User screen
entries.notes: Admins can now grant or revoke the oha_instructor secondary role directly from any user profile. Replaces need for separate plugin or code snippet. Checkbox only visible to administrators. Role is additive - user's primary role (e.g. subscriber) is unchanged. Requires one-time add_role() snippet to register oha_instructor on the site.

entries.summary: Renamed tutor_instructor role slug to oha_instructor throughout plugin
entries.notes: Site no longer uses TutorLMS so the tutor_instructor role slug is not registered. Changed to oha_instructor for clarity and independence. Updated all role checks, get_users queries, dropdown hints, and docblock comments.

entries.summary: Hardened save_meta sanitization: enum allowlists, revision guard, instructor role check
entries.notes: Four fixes: (1) Nonce verification was already present. (2) Added explicit wp_is_post_revision() guard alongside DOING_AUTOSAVE check. (3) Select fields (event_type, platform, access_level, event_status) now validated against allowlist - arbitrary strings stored as empty string. (4) Instructor user ID now validated with get_userdata() + role check against administrator/oha_board/oha_instructor before saving. Invalid IDs silently preserve existing value.

entries.summary: Added pre-recorded YouTube video support as a first-class platform type
entries.notes: New platform option: prerecorded. Pre-recorded events suppress the Zoom section entirely on the event page. Replay card shows Watch Session instead of Event Replay. Shortcode On Demand query handles pre-recorded videos automatically via existing status=replay + replay_available=1 + archive_enabled=1 flags. No new meta keys needed. Workflow: upload to YouTube as unlisted, paste video ID into yt_replay_id, set status to replay, check both archive and replay flags.

entries.summary: Fixed Zoom start URL expiration by constructing URL from Meeting ID at render time
entries.notes: Stored Zoom start URLs contain a ZAK token that expires in ~90 days. Solution: construct start URL dynamically as zoom.us/s/{MeetingID} which never expires and requires the host to be signed into Zoom. The oha_ve_zoom_start_url meta field is now Phase 2 only - if set it overrides the constructed URL but should only be filled by the API.

entries.summary: Fixed upcoming events sort order in hub shortcodes
entries.notes: Shortcodes were ordering by post date DESC (creation order) instead of actual event date. Added oha_ve_start_date meta field (YYYY-MM-DD date input). Upcoming and Teaching shortcode queries use meta_key=oha_ve_start_date with orderby=meta_value ASC so events sort soonest-first. Admin must enter same date as GD event date.

entries.summary: Added oha_ve_show_in_hub checkbox to control shortcode visibility per event
entries.notes: Board members can uncheck Show in Hub to keep an event off the My Account shortcode output while still making the event page accessible by direct URL. Defaults to checked (on) for new events. Teaching query skips the hub filter so instructors always see their assigned events.

entries.summary: Removed board_meeting event type - board meetings moved to permanent Zoom room in Board Hub
entries.notes: Board meetings do not need GeoDirectory events. They use a permanent Zoom room configured with Only authenticated users can join plus waiting room, restricted to verified board member Zoom accounts. Removed board_meeting from event type dropdown and from all queries.

entries.summary: Corrected WordPress role slugs throughout - was using wrong role names from v1.0.0
entries.notes: v1.0.0 used incorrect role slugs: board_member, actor, vendor, member. Correct slugs are: oha_board (WP role in wp_capabilities), subscriber (paid member), listing_owner (free listing owner). Note: board-member is the UsersWP account type for My Account display routing only - it is not a WP role and is not used for access control.

entries.summary: Added instructor assignment with Start Session vs Join Meeting button differentiation
entries.notes: New meta: oha_ve_instructor_user_id. Assigned instructor sees green Start Session button (zoom.us/s/MeetingID). Regular members see blue Join Meeting button (join URL). Board members and admins see both. Instructor dropdown populated from get_users() filtered to administrator, oha_board, oha_instructor roles.

entries.summary: Added five My Account shortcodes for Education and Events tab
entries.notes: Shortcodes: [oha_education_events] master hub, [oha_education_live] live now, [oha_education_upcoming] upcoming sorted by start date, [oha_education_teaching] instructor view, [oha_education_ondemand] replay library. All use WP_Query on oha_ve_ wp_postmeta fields. On Demand requires status=replay + replay_available=1 + archive_enabled=1.

entries.summary: Added event status field and archive/replay meta fields
entries.notes: New meta: oha_ve_event_status (upcoming/live/replay/closed/cancelled), oha_ve_archive_enabled, oha_ve_replay_available. Status must be changed manually in Phase 1 (upcoming to live when session starts, live to replay after recording is processed). Phase 2 will automate via Zoom webhooks.

entries.summary: Initial release - Phase 1 OHA Virtual Events plugin
entries.notes: Created new plugin extending events-for-geodirectory (gd_event post type). Admin meta box with virtual event settings. Frontend display with Zoom join button and YouTube embed. Access control by role. Replaced gd_show_events_on_place_page code snippet (shows upcoming events on haunt venue listing pages). Dependency checks for GeoDirectory core and Events for GeoDirectory. Warns if old snippet still active.

entries.summary: Add [oha_create_virtual_event] shortcode for board members to create Zoom events from the front end
entries.notes: Creates gd_event post (published immediately), inserts GD schedule row, sets all oha_ve_ meta, calls Zoom API. Access restricted to oha_board and admin roles.

entries.summary: Add timing-aware host launch and member join buttons on event pages
entries.notes: Instructor/board see Open Meeting + Copy Host Key button with 4-step instructions within configurable window (default 30 min before). Members see Join Now within their own window (default 15 min before). Outside window shows a notice with event date/time.

entries.summary: Add host key, join_before_host, instructor window, and member window to plugin settings
entries.notes: Host key stored as WP option, passed to frontend button via data attribute and copied to clipboard on click. join_before_host defaults on (disables waiting_room automatically). Both timing windows are admin-configurable in minutes.

entries.summary: Remove duplicate oha_ve_start_date field from admin meta box
entries.notes: Field was redundant with GD event_dates. Hub shortcode now sorts by GD schedule table via PHP usort instead of meta_key ordering.

entries.summary: Show/hide Zoom and YouTube sections in admin meta box based on platform selection
entries.notes: JS toggles #oha-ve-section-zoom and #oha-ve-section-youtube on platform dropdown change and on page load.

entries.summary: Auto-flip oha_ve_event_status to ended when GD expires a past event
entries.notes: Hooks into geodir_event_handle_past_event_after. Only acts on posts where oha_ve_enabled=1. Stops join/launch buttons appearing after event ends.

entries.summary: Fix timing window comparison using correct timezone-aware DateTime instead of strtotime+current_time
entries.notes: strtotime() uses PHP server timezone (usually UTC) while current_time(timestamp) uses WP local time, causing seconds_until to be inflated by the UTC offset. Fixed by using new DateTime with WP timezone and time() for comparison.

entries.summary: Use wp_timezone() for timing window calc to handle UTC-offset sites; add temporary admin debug output
entries.notes: get_option(timezone_string) returns empty on sites using UTC offset instead of named timezone. wp_timezone() handles both cases correctly. Debug line shows schedule date/time, timestamps, and secs_until for admin users only -- remove once timing confirmed.

entries.summary: Remove timing window restriction for host/instructor - host button now always visible regardless of event time
entries.notes: Timing window only applies to members now. Host always sees the launch button and session time. This eliminates the failure mode where timezone calc errors blocked the host from their own meeting controls.

entries.summary: Remove temporary admin debug output added in v1.4.2
entries.notes: Debug lines from the timezone investigation have been cleaned up.

entries.summary: Auto-compute live/ended event status from GD schedule - no manual status flip required
entries.notes: Schedule fetch moved before badge rendering. effective_status derived from start_ts/end_ts vs time(). If current time is between start and end: effective_status=live. If past end: effective_status=ended. Stored oha_ve_event_status still respected for cancelled/replay/closed states. LIVE NOW badge, member join heading, YouTube embed, and always_show flag all use effective_status.

entries.summary: Added 5-minute WP cron to auto-flip event status: upcoming to live at start, live to ended at end
entries.notes: Cron action oha_ve_auto_flip_statuses, interval oha_ve_5min (300s), registered in OHA_VE_Zoom_API constructor. Parses GD schedule start/end times as UTC. Eliminates need to manually flip status to Live.

entries.summary: Fixed event time displaying wrong hour by parsing GD schedule times as UTC instead of local time
entries.notes: GD stores wp_geodir_event_schedule times as UTC. Was previously treating them as local time causing offset inflation (e.g. 8pm showing as 1am on UTC-5 site).

entries.summary: Removed member timing window - members always see join button; Zoom join_before_host handles access control
entries.notes: Removed seconds_until, always_show, in_member_window logic from frontend.php. OPT_MEMBER_WINDOW setting still registered but no longer applied.

entries.summary: Removed oha_ve_zoom_start_url field; start URL now always built from meeting ID which never expires
entries.notes: zoom.us/s/{ID} is permanent. Stored start URL token expired after 90 days. Removed from admin meta box render, save_meta URLs array, and frontend read.

entries.summary: Removed oha_ve_zoom_recording and oha_ve_archive_enabled meta fields; merged into single replay_available checkbox
entries.notes: archive_enabled filter removed from query_events in shortcodes.php. Admin Section 6 simplified to one checkbox. On Demand query now only requires status=replay and replay_available=1.

entries.summary: Fixed 403 cookie check failed error on Zoom join redirect - renamed _wpnonce param to _token
entries.notes: WordPress REST API intercepts _wpnonce and verifies it as wp_rest nonce, which fails for our custom oha_ve_zoom_join_{id} nonce. Renamed to _token in get_protected_join_url() and zoom_join_redirect() to avoid the collision.

entries.summary: Zoom API sync suite: host key sync, reschedule sync, cancel/trash delete, recording fetch
entries.notes: Requires user:read:admin scope on Zoom app for host key sync. New settings toggles for auto-reschedule, auto-cancel-delete, auto-trash-delete. New post meta: oha_ve_zoom_synced_start, oha_ve_zoom_synced_at.

entries.summary: Replace the_content filter with direct action hook to eliminate duplicate events on haunt listing pages
entries.notes: display_events_on_place_page removed from the_content filter. New render_place_events method hooked to oha_place_page_events action. Haunt listing display template calls do_action(oha_place_page_events, listing_id) after the About section. Removed empty-events placeholder (Seasonal Attraction fallback text) - nothing renders when no events exist.

entries.summary: Shortcode event cards now parse GD schedule times as UTC, consistent with frontend.php v1.5.0 fix
entries.notes: render_event_card() was using strtotime() without timezone on schedule start_date+start_time. GD stores times as UTC; strtotime on a non-UTC PHP server inflates the displayed time by the UTC offset. Fixed to use new DateTime(..., UTC)->getTimestamp() matching get_frontend_schedule() in class-oha-ve-frontend.php.

entries.summary: Live banner cancelled-event window check now uses time() and UTC DateTime instead of current_time+strtotime
entries.notes: sc_live_banner() was using current_time(timestamp) vs strtotime() for the cancelled-event window comparison. current_time(timestamp) is offset by the WP site timezone while strtotime() uses PHP server timezone (UTC on most hosts). Could cause the cancelled banner to appear or auto-close at the wrong time. Replaced with time() and new DateTime(..., UTC) throughout the cancelled-event block and banner time string calculation.

entries.summary: Board create form now converts entered local time to UTC before writing GD event schedule row
entries.notes: insert_event_schedule() in class-oha-ve-create.php was storing the admin-entered time directly without UTC conversion. GD stores schedule times as UTC and the auto-flip cron reads them as UTC. Entering 7:00 PM EDT stored 19:00:00, causing the cron to flip status to live at 7:00 PM UTC (3:00 PM EDT) -- 4 hours early. Fixed by converting via wp_timezone() before insertion. The Zoom API call was already correct (passes WP timezone in the start_time payload).

entries.summary: Shortcode event cards now parse GD schedule times as UTC, consistent with frontend.php v1.5.0 fix
entries.notes: render_event_card() was using strtotime() without timezone on schedule start_date+start_time. GD stores times as UTC; strtotime on a non-UTC PHP server inflates the displayed time by the UTC offset. Fixed to use new DateTime(..., UTC)->getTimestamp() matching get_frontend_schedule() in class-oha-ve-frontend.php.

entries.summary: Live banner cancelled-event window check now uses time() and UTC DateTime instead of current_time+strtotime
entries.notes: sc_live_banner() was using current_time(timestamp) vs strtotime() for the cancelled-event window comparison. current_time(timestamp) is offset by the WP site timezone while strtotime() uses PHP server timezone (UTC on most hosts). Could cause the cancelled banner to appear or auto-close at the wrong time. Replaced with time() and new DateTime(..., UTC) throughout the cancelled-event block and banner time string calculation.

entries.summary: Board create form now converts entered local time to UTC before writing GD event schedule row
entries.notes: insert_event_schedule() in class-oha-ve-create.php was storing the admin-entered time directly without UTC conversion. GD stores schedule times as UTC and the auto-flip cron reads them as UTC. Entering 7:00 PM EDT stored 19:00:00, causing the cron to flip status to live at 7:00 PM UTC (3:00 PM EDT) -- 4 hours early. Fixed by converting via wp_timezone() before insertion.

entries.summary: Board create form no longer creates a duplicate Zoom meeting when auto-create hook fires first
entries.notes: wp_insert_post() with post_status=publish synchronously fires the publish_gd_event hook, which calls maybe_create_meeting_on_publish() and creates meeting #1. handle_create() was then unconditionally calling create_meeting() a second time, creating meeting #2 (and meeting #3/#4 if the form was submitted twice). Fixed by checking for a non-empty oha_ve_zoom_id immediately after wp_insert_post -- if auto-create already ran, the explicit create_meeting() call is skipped.

entries.summary: Admin meta box save no longer clears API-written Zoom meeting ID and join URL when fields are submitted empty
entries.notes: save_meta() was unconditionally writing whatever appeared in the oha_ve_zoom_id and oha_ve_zoom_join_url inputs on every WP admin event save. If those fields appeared blank in the edit screen, a routine Save would overwrite the API-set values with empty strings. Fixed: both fields are now only written when the submitted value is non-empty, preserving whatever the Zoom API wrote.

entries.summary: Zoom API auto-create hook now fires only on first publish, not on every Update of an existing event
entries.notes: maybe_create_meeting_on_publish() was hooked to publish_gd_event, which fires on every save of a published post -- not just the first publish. This caused a new Zoom meeting to be created every time the admin hit Update on an existing event, particularly when oha_ve_zoom_id was blank. Changed to transition_post_status and added an early return when old_status is already publish, so auto-create only fires once when the event is first published.

entries.summary: Zoom API auto-create now saves passcode from API response to oha_ve_zoom_passcode meta
entries.notes: create_meeting() was saving zoom_id, join_url, uuid, and start_url from the Zoom API response but not the password field. oha_ve_zoom_passcode was left blank on every auto-created meeting, requiring manual entry. Fixed by saving $data[password] to oha_ve_zoom_passcode alongside the other fields.

entries.summary: Platform dropdown labels rewritten to describe workflow instead of tech stack
entries.notes: Previous labels (e.g. "Zoom (live interactive session)") described the technology. New labels describe the use case: "Zoom - Live meeting (upload recording to YouTube after)", "Pre-Recorded - YouTube upload only, no live session", etc. Eliminates confusion about which option to pick for standard OHA class workflow.

entries.summary: YouTube and Replay admin sections merged into single Archive and Replay section
entries.notes: Previously two separate sections (YouTube Video and Replay) with overlapping workflow explanations. Merged into one "Archive & Replay" section. YouTube Live Stream ID field is now hidden for Zoom and Pre-Recorded platforms -- only visible for YouTube Live / simulcast. Replay ID field label renamed to "YouTube Recording Video ID" with inline step-by-step workflow guide.

entries.summary: Checking Replay is Ready auto-sets Status to Replay, and vice versa -- only one action needed
entries.notes: Previously the admin had to both change Status to Replay/On Demand AND check the Replay is Ready checkbox. Now they sync automatically via JS (bidirectional). Server-side also enforces: if status=replay is saved, replay_available is forced to 1 regardless of checkbox state. Eliminates the two-step confusion.

entries.summary: New oha_ve_replay CPT for standalone on-demand video entries, independent of GeoDirectory events
entries.notes: Registers post type with show_ui=true, public=false. WP Admin > Replays > Add New. Meta box fields: YouTube video ID, presenter/instructor name, date recorded, access level (subscriber_only/all_members/board_only/public), event type, resources URL, admin notes. Convention session recordings and education replays go here -- no GD event stub needed. Queries ordered by oha_ve_replay_date DESC.

entries.summary: On Demand shortcode queries oha_ve_replay CPT instead of gd_events with replay_available flag
entries.notes: sc_ondemand() in class-oha-ve-shortcodes.php now calls OHA_VE_Replay_CPT::query_replays(). Cards use render_replay_card() with a Watch Now button that expands an inline YouTube iframe (toggle JS emitted once per page via window.ohaReplayToggleInit guard). Access control reads oha_ve_replay_access via OHA_VE_Frontend::user_has_access(). Existing gd_event replay entries (e.g. Sept 29 class) must be re-created as oha_ve_replay posts to appear in the library.

entries.summary: Removed GD expiry re-publish hack from mark_ended_on_expire; GD events now expire naturally
entries.notes: mark_ended_on_expire() in class-oha-ve-zoom-api.php previously re-published GD events when oha_ve_replay_available=1 to keep them visible in the on-demand library. This required a private republishing guard flag and wp_update_post() to override GD. Now that replays live in oha_ve_replay CPT, GD events can expire normally. Simplified to: if oha_ve_enabled, set oha_ve_event_status=ended. Removed the republishing property from OHA_VE_Zoom_API class.

entries.summary: New oha_ve_replay CPT for standalone on-demand video entries, independent of GeoDirectory events
entries.notes: Registers post type with show_ui=true, public=false. WP Admin > Replays > Add New. Meta box fields: YouTube video ID, presenter/instructor name, date recorded, access level (subscriber_only/all_members/board_only/public), event type, resources URL, admin notes. Convention session recordings and education replays go here -- no GD event stub needed. Queries ordered by oha_ve_replay_date DESC.

entries.summary: On Demand shortcode queries oha_ve_replay CPT instead of gd_events with replay_available flag
entries.notes: sc_ondemand() in class-oha-ve-shortcodes.php now calls OHA_VE_Replay_CPT::query_replays(). Cards use render_replay_card() with a Watch Now button that expands an inline YouTube iframe (toggle JS emitted once per page via window.ohaReplayToggleInit guard). Access control reads oha_ve_replay_access via OHA_VE_Frontend::user_has_access(). Existing gd_event replay entries (e.g. Sept 29 class) must be re-created as oha_ve_replay posts to appear in the library.

entries.summary: Removed GD expiry re-publish hack from mark_ended_on_expire; GD events now expire naturally
entries.notes: mark_ended_on_expire() in class-oha-ve-zoom-api.php previously re-published GD events when oha_ve_replay_available=1 to keep them visible in the on-demand library. This required a private republishing guard flag and wp_update_post() to override GD. Now that replays live in oha_ve_replay CPT, GD events can expire normally. Simplified to: if oha_ve_enabled, set oha_ve_event_status=ended. Removed the republishing property from OHA_VE_Zoom_API class.

entries.summary: Fixed Zoom auto-create not firing when event is published or saved via WP admin
entries.notes: Moved auto-create hook from transition_post_status (fires during wp_insert_post before meta is saved) to save_post_gd_event priority 30 (fires after OHA_VE_Admin::save_meta() at priority 20). This ensures oha_ve_enabled and oha_ve_platform are already in the DB when the auto-create check runs. The zoom_id guard prevents duplicate meetings on routine saves. The board create form explicit create_meeting() call is unaffected. Added DOING_AUTOSAVE guard.

entries.summary: Import from event now pulls featured image and post content (description)
entries.notes: ajax_get_event_data() returns thumbnail_id, thumbnail_url, and description (wp_kses_post of post_content). JS fills the WP classic editor (#content / TinyMCE) with the event description. Thumbnail preview shown in import section. Hidden oha_ve_replay_import_thumb field carries the attachment ID to save_meta(). On save: if field is set and replay has no existing featured image, set_post_thumbnail() is called. User can freely override both after import.

entries.summary: Replay cards redesigned to match HLD archive card style
entries.notes: render_replay_card() rebuilt with .oha-replay-card structure: 160px featured image (cover-fit, scale on hover), dark #111 bg, warm rgba border with gold hover glow, Cinzel title, Rajdhani type badge overlay on image, muted #8a9ab0 presenter/date. Watch Now button (red) and Resources link in card footer. sc_ondemand() wraps cards in .oha-replay-grid CSS grid (3-col/2-col/1-col responsive). oha-virtual-events.css gets Google Fonts import for Cinzel + Rajdhani; old .oha-edu-card--replay rules replaced.

entries.summary: Watch Now toggle JS assigned to window.ohaReplayToggle to fix strict-mode scoping
entries.notes: function declaration inside if(){} block is not hoisted to global scope in strict-mode page contexts (Kadence theme). Changed to window.ohaReplayToggle=function(){} assignment so onclick attribute can always find it.

entries.summary: Watch Now toggle uses event delegation instead of onclick attributes
entries.notes: Both Watch Now button and thumbnail play button carry class oha-replay-toggle. document.addEventListener click delegation fires the toggle logic. Fixes Kadence strict-mode scoping issue where function declarations inside if() blocks were not hoisted to global scope. Previous fix (window.ohaReplayToggle assignment) was insufficient; event delegation is more reliable across all page contexts.

entries.summary: Replay cards redesigned to Netflix/streaming preview style
entries.notes: YouTube thumbnail auto-pulled via img.youtube.com/vi/{ID}/maxresdefault.jpg with onerror fallback to hqdefault.jpg -- no API key needed. 16:9 ratio via padding-bottom:56.25% on .oha-replay-card__thumb. Dark gradient overlay at bottom of image contains type badge, Cinzel title, Rajdhani presenter/date. Play button circle fades in on card hover. Watch Now + More Info buttons in footer below thumbnail.

entries.summary: More Info modal shows description, presenter, date, duration, and resources link
entries.notes: Clicking More Info button opens full-screen modal overlay. Data passed via data-info JSON attribute (esc_attr + wp_json_encode in PHP). Modal populated via JS: title, type badge, duration, presenter, date, description (wp_strip_all_tags of post_content, displayed as plain text). Resources link shown only if http/https URL is set. Close via X button, ESC key, or backdrop click. Modal HTML emitted once per page via PHP static $modal_output flag.

entries.summary: Duration meta field added to replay post (oha_ve_replay_duration)
entries.notes: Manual text field in replay admin meta box next to Date Recorded, e.g. "1h 23m" or "45 min". Saved via existing text_fields sanitize loop in save_meta(). Displayed as a dark pill badge top-right corner of thumbnail on card. Also shown in the More Info modal meta row.

entries.summary: Move replay JS to enqueued file so it works inside UsersWP iframe + AJAX tabs
entries.notes: Root cause: [oha_uwp_account_inline] loads My Account in an iframe; UsersWP loads tab content via AJAX. Inline script tags in shortcode output do not reliably execute in AJAX-injected content. Fix: all toggle and modal logic moved to assets/js/oha-ve-replay.js, enqueued via wp_enqueue_script (in_footer=true) on every frontend page. The file loads during the iframe initial page render, attaches document-level event delegation, and is already active when UsersWP injects tab content. Inline <script> block removed from sc_ondemand(); modal HTML (static $modal_output flag) stays in shortcode output as plain HTML.

entries.summary: Remove redundant thumbnail play button from replay cards
entries.notes: The hover-reveal SVG play button on the card thumbnail did the same thing as the Watch Now button in the footer. Removed the .oha-replay-card__play button element from render_replay_card() and its CSS rules. Watch Now in the footer is the sole toggle trigger.

entries.summary: Replace More Info floating modal with inline card panel -- modal breaks inside auto-height iframes
entries.notes: position:fixed inside an iframe that auto-sizes its height is relative to the iframe content area, not the browser viewport. The modal appeared stretched across the full iframe height and got cut off. Fix: removed modal entirely. More Info now toggles a .oha-replay-card__info-panel div that expands below card actions in normal document flow. Button label toggles More Info / Less Info. No fixed positioning used. JS simplified -- modal open/close and ESC/backdrop handlers removed.

entries.summary: Replace WP nonce with HMAC token on Zoom join redirect URL to fix link-has-expired error
entries.notes: wp_verify_nonce() is user-session-dependent. WordPress REST API does not authenticate users from cookies without X-WP-Nonce header (removed in v1.5.1 to prevent 403), so get_current_user_id() returns 0 in the REST callback and nonces created for the logged-in admin fail. Fix: get_protected_join_url() now builds a token as {expires}|{16-char-hmac-sig} using wp_hash() with WP secret salts. verify_zoom_token() checks expiry and hash_equals the signature. No user session dependency. Token valid for 1 hour from page render.

entries.summary: Skip meeting acknowledgment page for board/admin/instructor on Zoom join redirect
entries.notes: Board members and instructors now redirect straight to Zoom without the acknowledgment step. Members still see the acknowledgment page. Change in zoom_join_redirect(): the ack page block is gated on ! && !.

entries.summary: Fix Zoom join redirect -- manual auth cookie fallback so is_user_logged_in works in REST context
entries.notes: WP REST API does not authenticate users from session cookies without X-WP-Nonce. After the HMAC token check passes, if is_user_logged_in returns false the callback now manually iterates $_COOKIE for wordpress_logged_in_* entries and calls wp_validate_auth_cookie + wp_set_current_user to restore the session. Without this the login redirect bounced users to the event page instead of Zoom.

entries.summary: Change host button from button+onclick to anchor with target=_blank for reliable tab opening
entries.notes: Replaced button with onclick="ohaVeHostLaunch" with an a href pointing to REST URL with target=_blank. Browser-native target=_blank is not subject to popup blocker rules and always sends cookies. window.open removed entirely. get_host_launch_js now attaches a click event listener that only handles clipboard copy as a side effect. data-join-url attribute removed from element -- URL is now in href.

entries.summary: Change HMAC token separator from pipe to dot to avoid esc_url percent-encoding edge cases
entries.notes: add_query_arg encodes | as %7C. esc_url then decodes %7C back to | since pipe is in its allowed set. The literal | in the URL worked but was fragile. Changed make_zoom_token and verify_zoom_token to use dot as separator. Token format is now {expires}.{16-char-hex-sig}. Existing v1.8.2 tokens are invalidated but v1.8.2 was never uploaded to the live site.

entries.summary: CSS not loading on UWP profile tab pages; has_shortcode check only inspects post_content
entries.notes: maybe_enqueue_styles() now loads CSS unconditionally on all frontend pages, same pattern as enqueue_replay_script(). The shortcode lives in UWP tab data, not post_content, so has_shortcode always returned false. Without CSS the replay embed had zero height so Watch Now appeared to do nothing.

entries.summary: Replay grid changed from 3-column to 2-column default; drops to 1-column below 576px
entries.notes: Removed the 900px 2-col breakpoint; 2-col is now the base. User requested smaller cards via 2-column layout.

entries.summary: Watch Now toggle fails in UWP profile tab context; switched from getElementById to card-relative querySelector
entries.notes: document.getElementById cannot locate the embed div when the replay shortcode is rendered inside a UWP profile tab container. Changed Watch Now handler in oha-ve-replay.js to use tb.closest(.oha-replay-card) then card.querySelector(.oha-replay-embed) -- same pattern as the working More Info handler. Also updated document.querySelectorAll for watch button text to card.querySelectorAll.

entries.summary: Clicking the replay thumbnail now also triggers Watch Now toggle
entries.notes: Added oha-replay-toggle class and data-target attr to .oha-replay-card__thumb div (only when yt_safe is set). Added cursor:pointer to thumbnail CSS.

entries.summary: Watch Now and More Info now overlay the thumbnail in-place instead of expanding below the card
entries.notes: Embed and info panel moved inside .oha-replay-card__thumb as position:absolute overlays (z-index 2 and 3). Prevents CSS grid row height distortion in 2-col layout that caused blank black box in adjacent card. JS updated to close one overlay when the other opens (mutual exclusion).
